name: ISO/IEC 42001
notice: Requirement IDs and headings with Assayr's own summaries. Use your licensed copy of ISO/IEC 42001 for the requirement text.

clauses.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
Understanding the organization and its context
clauses.summary: Work out the internal and external issues that affect your AI work, including your role as AI provider, developer or user, and the laws and expectations around AI that apply to you.
clauses.evidence_hint: Context analysis that covers AI roles, issues and climate considerations

clauses.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
clauses.summary: List the people and bodies that care about your AI systems, such as users, affected individuals and regulators, and decide which of their requirements you will meet.
clauses.evidence_hint: Interested parties register with their AI-related requirements

clauses.title: Determining the scope of the AI management system
clauses.summary: Decide and write down which AI systems, activities, sites and roles the AI management system covers, and why anything is left out.
clauses.evidence_hint: Approved AI management system scope statement

clauses.title: AI management system
clauses.summary: Set up, run, maintain and keep improving an AI management system with the processes this standard expects.
clauses.evidence_hint: Description of the AI management system and how its processes connect

clauses.title: Leadership and commitment
clauses.summary: Top management shows it owns the AI management system: it sets direction, provides resources, aligns AI with business goals and supports responsible AI.
clauses.evidence_hint: Management minutes or statements showing commitment and resourcing

clauses.title: AI policy
clauses.summary: Top management approves an AI policy that fits the organisation, gives a frame for AI objectives and commits to meeting requirements and improving.
clauses.evidence_hint: Approved, published AI policy

clauses.title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
clauses.summary: Assign and communicate who is responsible for the AI management system and for reporting on how it performs.
clauses.evidence_hint: Roles and responsibilities document or RACI for AI

clauses.title: General
clauses.summary: Plan how to deal with the risks and opportunities that could stop the AI management system achieving its intended results, separating acceptable from unacceptable risk.
clauses.evidence_hint: Risk and opportunity planning record for the AI management system

clauses.title: AI risk assessment
clauses.summary: Define and use a repeatable way to identify, analyse and evaluate AI risks, considering the AI system impact assessment results.
clauses.evidence_hint: AI risk assessment method and completed assessment

clauses.title: AI risk treatment
clauses.summary: Choose treatment options for AI risks, pick the needed controls (comparing with Annex A), produce a statement of applicability and get risk owners to approve the plan.
clauses.evidence_hint: AI risk treatment plan and statement of applicability

clauses.title: AI system impact assessment
clauses.summary: Have a process to assess the possible consequences of AI systems for individuals, groups and society across their life cycle, and use the results in risk assessment.
clauses.evidence_hint: AI system impact assessment procedure and completed assessments

clauses.title: AI objectives and planning to achieve them
clauses.summary: Set measurable AI objectives at relevant levels and plan what will be done, by whom, with what resources and by when.
clauses.evidence_hint: AI objectives with owners, measures and plans

clauses.title: Planning of changes
clauses.summary: Make changes to the AI management system in a planned way.
clauses.evidence_hint: Change records for the AI management system

clauses.title: Resources
clauses.summary: Provide the people, money, tools and infrastructure the AI management system needs.
clauses.evidence_hint: Budget or resource plan for the AI management system

clauses.title: Competence
clauses.summary: Decide what competence people working on AI need, make sure they have it through education, training or experience, and keep proof.
clauses.evidence_hint: Competence matrix and training records for AI roles

clauses.title: Awareness
clauses.summary: Make sure people know the AI policy, how they contribute and what happens if they do not follow the AI management system.
clauses.evidence_hint: Awareness sessions or acknowledgements of the AI policy

clauses.title: Communication
clauses.summary: Decide what to communicate about the AI management system, when, to whom and how.
clauses.evidence_hint: Communication plan for AI topics

clauses.title: General
clauses.summary: Keep the documented information the standard requires and that you need for the AI management system to work.
clauses.evidence_hint: List of AI management system documents and records

clauses.title: Creating and updating documented information
clauses.summary: Give documents proper identification, format and review and approval when you create or change them.
clauses.evidence_hint: Document template and approval history

clauses.title: Control of documented information
clauses.summary: Keep AI management system documents available, protected, versioned, retained and disposed of in a controlled way.
clauses.evidence_hint: Document control procedure and register

clauses.title: Operational planning and control
clauses.summary: Plan, run and control the processes needed for AI, including outsourced ones, and keep records that they ran as planned.
clauses.evidence_hint: Operating procedures and records for AI processes

clauses.title: AI risk assessment
clauses.summary: Run AI risk assessments at planned intervals and when significant changes happen, and keep the results.
clauses.evidence_hint: Dated AI risk assessment results

clauses.title: AI risk treatment
clauses.summary: Carry out the AI risk treatment plan and check that it works.
clauses.evidence_hint: Treatment progress and verification records

clauses.title: AI system impact assessment
clauses.summary: Run AI system impact assessments at planned intervals and when significant changes happen, and keep the results.
clauses.evidence_hint: Dated AI system impact assessments

clauses.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
clauses.summary: Decide what to monitor and measure about AI, how and when, and evaluate the results.
clauses.evidence_hint: AI performance and effectiveness metrics with analysis

clauses.title: General
clauses.summary: Audit the AI management system at planned intervals to check it meets requirements and works in practice.
clauses.evidence_hint: Internal audit reports for the AI management system

clauses.title: Internal audit programme
clauses.summary: Plan an audit programme with frequency, methods, criteria and scope, use objective auditors and report results to management.
clauses.evidence_hint: Audit programme and auditor assignments

clauses.title: General
clauses.summary: Top management reviews the AI management system at planned intervals to make sure it stays suitable, adequate and effective.
clauses.evidence_hint: Management review minutes

clauses.title: Management review inputs
clauses.summary: Bring the required inputs to management review, such as audit results, objectives, risks, feedback and changes.
clauses.evidence_hint: Management review pack with all inputs

clauses.title: Management review results
clauses.summary: Record management review decisions on improvements and changes to the AI management system.
clauses.evidence_hint: Recorded decisions and actions from management review

clauses.title: Continual improvement
clauses.summary: Keep improving how suitable, adequate and effective the AI management system is.
clauses.evidence_hint: Improvement log or plan

clauses.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
clauses.summary: When something does not conform, react, find the cause, fix it, check the fix worked and keep records.
clauses.evidence_hint: Nonconformity and corrective action register

objectives.title: Information for interested parties of AI systems

controls.title: AI policy
controls.summary: Write down a policy for how the organisation develops or uses AI systems.

controls.title: Alignment with other organizational policies
controls.summary: Check where other policies such as security, privacy and quality touch AI, and update them or the AI policy so they fit together.

controls.title: Review of the AI policy
controls.summary: Review the AI policy at planned intervals, or when things change, so it stays suitable and effective.

controls.title: AI roles and responsibilities
controls.summary: Define and assign the roles and responsibilities needed for AI across the organisation.
controls.evidence_hint: AI roles and responsibilities with named owners

controls.title: Reporting of concerns
controls.summary: Give people a way to raise concerns about the organisation's role with AI systems throughout their life cycle.

controls.title: Resource documentation
controls.summary: Identify and document the resources each AI system needs at each stage of its life cycle.

controls.title: Data resources
controls.summary: Document the data used by AI systems: where it comes from, its categories, quality and how it is prepared.
controls.evidence_hint: Data resource records for AI systems

controls.title: Tooling resources
controls.summary: Document the tools used to build and run AI systems, such as frameworks, libraries and model platforms.

controls.title: System and computing resources
controls.summary: Document the computing and system resources AI systems rely on, including where they run.

controls.title: Human resources
controls.summary: Document the people and skills needed to develop, run and oversee AI systems.
controls.evidence_hint: Staffing and skills plan for AI

controls.title: AI system impact assessment process
controls.summary: Have a process for assessing what an AI system could do to individuals, groups and society, and repeat it when needed.
controls.evidence_hint: Impact assessment procedure with review schedule

controls.title: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
controls.summary: Record the results of AI system impact assessments and keep them for a defined period.

controls.title: Assessing AI system impact on individuals or groups of individuals
controls.summary: Assess and record the possible effects of AI systems on people, such as fairness, privacy and safety.

controls.title: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
controls.summary: Assess and record the possible effects of AI systems on society, such as the environment, economy and public trust.

controls.title: Objectives for responsible development of AI system
controls.summary: Set and document objectives that guide responsible AI development, and build measures for them into the life cycle.

controls.title: Processes for responsible AI system design and development
controls.summary: Define and document the processes used to design and develop AI systems responsibly.

controls.title: AI system requirements and specification
controls.summary: Specify and document requirements for new AI systems or major changes.
controls.evidence_hint: Requirements specification for each AI system

controls.title: Documentation of AI system design and development
controls.summary: Document the design and development of each AI system, including its architecture and key choices.

controls.title: AI system verification and validation
controls.summary: Define and document how AI systems are verified and validated, with criteria for passing.
controls.evidence_hint: Test and validation plan with results

controls.title: AI system deployment
controls.summary: Document a deployment plan and make sure the requirements are met before an AI system goes live.

controls.title: AI system operation and monitoring
controls.summary: Define what is needed to run and monitor AI systems, including performance, repairs and updates.
controls.evidence_hint: Operating and monitoring procedures with records

controls.title: AI system technical documentation
controls.summary: Decide what technical documentation each audience needs and provide it.
controls.evidence_hint: Technical documentation pack per AI system

controls.title: AI system recording of event logs
controls.summary: Decide at which life cycle stages event logging is needed, and turn it on at least while the AI system is in use.

controls.title: Data for development and enhancement of AI system
controls.summary: Define and run data management processes for the data used to build and improve AI systems.

controls.title: Acquisition of data
controls.summary: Decide and document how data for AI systems is obtained, including its source and rights to use it.

controls.title: Quality of data for AI systems
controls.summary: Set data quality requirements and make sure data used for AI meets them.

controls.title: Data provenance
controls.summary: Record where AI data came from and what happened to it over its life cycle.

controls.title: Data preparation
controls.summary: Define and document how data is selected, cleaned and prepared for AI systems.

controls.title: System documentation and information for users
controls.summary: Give users the information they need about an AI system, such as what it does and its limits.
controls.evidence_hint: User-facing documentation for each AI system

controls.title: External reporting
controls.summary: Let interested parties report problems or adverse effects of an AI system.
controls.evidence_hint: External reporting channel and its handling records

controls.title: Communication of incidents
controls.summary: Plan how to tell users and others about incidents involving an AI system.

controls.title: Information for interested parties
controls.summary: Decide and document what you must report about AI systems to interested parties, such as regulators.

controls.title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
controls.summary: Define and document processes for using AI systems responsibly.

controls.title: Objectives for responsible use of AI system
controls.summary: Set and document objectives that guide responsible use of AI systems.

controls.title: Intended use of the AI system
controls.summary: Make sure AI systems are used as intended and in line with their documentation.
controls.evidence_hint: Intended use statement and usage checks

controls.title: Allocating responsibilities
controls.summary: Split responsibilities for AI between the organisation, its partners, suppliers and customers.

controls.title: Suppliers
controls.summary: Make sure services, products and materials from suppliers fit your approach to responsible AI.

controls.title: Customers
controls.summary: Take your customers' expectations and needs into account when you provide AI products and services.
controls.evidence_hint: Customer requirements and terms for AI
